changelog:
The interface release. MobileIPTV is still a player — you supply your own source,
nothing is bundled — but almost every screen has been redrawn.

**Look and feel**
- The app now runs on a single declared theme rather than Material's stock dark
  scheme, so no unstyled control can surface a purple that belongs to another app.
- A four-tab bar frames every list: Home, Movies, Series and More. Sources,
  Categories, Content languages and Settings live under More — they used to be
  four tappable lines in the middle of the channel list.
- Pop-up dialogs are gone. Every one of them is a bottom sheet now.
- Lists load with skeletons in the shape of the content that is arriving, not
  spinners.
- Empty and failed lists explain themselves: a glyph, a title, a sentence saying
  why, and something to tap. Never a blank screen.
- The window and system bars match the app's own background, and on Android 12+
  the cold-launch splash is no longer a white frame.

**Movies and Series**
- Both browse as a poster grid, drawing the cover art your provider supplies.
  This is the first time the app has drawn provider artwork anywhere.
- New detail screen: a blurred hero image, poster, synopsis, and a metadata line,
  with Play or Episodes as the primary action and Favourite beside it.
- Tapping a film now opens that detail screen instead of starting playback
  immediately.
- Series show season chips and episode rows with 16:9 thumbnails.
- "More like this" suggests other titles from the same category in your own
  catalog. It needs no account and no network, and is left out when the category
  has nothing else to offer.

**Titles and artwork**
- Series pick up a synopsis, year, runtime and rating with no API key of any
  kind, from TVmaze. This means the app now contacts api.tvmaze.com, sending the
  series title, the first time you open a series it has not looked up before.
- Matching is on an exact normalised title, so provider decorations like
  "EN - The Office (US) UHD" still resolve. Shows that genuinely share a name can
  still match the wrong entry.
- Films show a quality tag read out of the provider's own title.
- Answers are cached for 30 days and come back instantly, including offline.
- TMDB support is built and is inert in this build: no key ships with it.

**Live TV**
- The channel row is redrawn: a per-source colour edge, a logo tile, now and next
  with a progress line that advances while you watch the list, and a favourite
  star you can tap in the row itself.
- Long-pressing a row can now open that channel's schedule.
- The row shows programme titles without start times.

**Sources and importing**
- Adding a playlist by URL works. The M3U parse ran on the calling thread, and
  every real playlist failed on it.
- You can add a playlist from a file on the device, not only from a URL.
- M3U playlists get a guide. A playlist that declares its own EPG URL had that
  URL parsed and then ignored.
- A newly added source loads its guide immediately instead of at the next launch.
- Importing shows named phases and counts instead of one undifferentiated spinner,
  and a failed import names the fault.
- Adding a source you have already added is refused rather than silently
  duplicating the catalog.

**Catch-up**
- Xtream catch-up: programmes on a channel's schedule offer "Watch from
  beginning" when your provider carries an archive for that channel. Playing an
  archived programme never disturbs the live channel.
- Not yet verified against a real provider archive, and a catch-up stream is
  still treated as live by the stall detector.

**Faster**
- Searching for text that has not matched yet is substantially quicker.

**Updates**
- The update prompt is a bottom sheet, and offers Retry when a download fails.

**Upgrading from v0.1.2**
- Your sources, favourites, watch history and category choices are preserved.
- The first refresh after upgrading rewrites each catalog, so expect one longer
  refresh than usual.
- Existing sources report no catch-up channels until you refresh them once.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build.
